Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

High stress, especially violence, usually triggers plaguing memories of your Creation Rites. Whenever you see a Storyteller, hear a specific word, or encounter a certain type of event, your thoughts immediately return to the time of your creation, and you feel a pressing need to share these memories with whoever is around.

Trigger/Effect: You are down one Mental Trait whenever you lapse into these memories.
